company_info.company_description: "Lite Force Electrical is the leading contractor for all your electrical, solar, and air-conditioning needs. Local, and friendly service minus the extended wait times with quality workmanship at an affordable price."

reviews.review_description: Easy process to deal with Lite force. Honest quote and happy with the install.System does everything it said on the tin!
Quoting process was easy, installation was tidy and workmen polite. Great customer experience and would recommend as a quality, trustworthy installer.

Rory from Lite Force Pty Ltd and his team were excellent from start to finish.From the first meeting, I was impressed by his knowledge, experience, customer focus and attention to detail.The installation team and office admin team were also brilliant to deal with.If you're looking for a company that really care about doing a great job, care about getting you the right system and an owner that is committed to meeting and exceeding your expectations with great after-sales service - don't even hesitate, just select them.

Factual sales quoting process, punctual and tidy installation with a very polite team. System was up and running immediately after the install. Great admin team, very friendly and quickly and efficiently sorted all the required paperwork.

Lite Force was recommended to me as a trusted installer by the Solar Quotes website. Rory (Director and installer) was able to fit the solar panels according to my preferred layout, which was not the case for other installers I consulted who preferred an easier option. I am very pleased with the result and highly recommend Lite Force for their expertise and friendly, efficient service.
These guys went over and above to help us, we had solar installed within roughly 1 week and the customer service was awesome

Met with owner of Lite Force.  He was very informative and offered quality products.  Explained future battery attachment and EV charging if required in the future.Installation went smoothly with installers arriving promptly and cleaning up all mess before they left.

We had three quotes; one never followed up after the initial meeting and two did. Of these Liteforce was the most attentive. They gave me confidence of a good product that was matched to our requirement. It was also very tailored to the particulars of our house from an installation point of view. On the day the installation team were on time, did a tidy job and left no mess.

Very happy with my solar system.  Rory came out to my house to quote, design the system and talk me through the whole system and installation procedure. The guys who installed the system were very professional and took care of my ageing tiled roof. It was great to see Rory come out and supervise and even get hands on with the install of the system. The admin team were always very prompt and super friendly when dealing with any queries I had. Can highly recommend Lite Force Solar
Install was easy and near.  installer was approachable and answered questions well. Too early to understand system performance.

Rory knew his trade and informed me precisely what would be required with out any sales pitches. the team was punctual professional polite and tidy. Lite force organised everything including the heat pump and installation.

I would usually complete a fair amount of research and explore various options when choosing a product or service to get the best value for my money, except in this case (due to time constraints) my choice of installer was based purely on a recommendation. Something I would never normally do...However this was a great experience, and the results were truly exceptional!Rory from Lite Force Pty Ltd was highly professional, honest and easy to deal with when choosing the right system, and I could not be happier.Our system was installed by both Rory and Jordan whom completed the installation to an exceptionally high standard, and quality of workmanship - the most important aspect of the whole process.I am confident that I will get peak performance from my solar system for many years to come, and have no hesitation whatsoever in recommending Rory from Lite Force Pty Ltd for your solar installation needs.Thankyou once again!Chris - Inglewood
I highly recommend Lite Force Solar, excellent service and installation.Competitively priced. The whole team was a pleasure to work with.

Rory is an excellent owner operator solar panel company and comes highly recommended from a renewable energy construction manager from the mine site. Rory provides an exceptional level of experience and insight to the role of installing solar panels, making recommendations that will see optimization of return of investment over the life of the panels and is very knowledgeable in the area.Rory installed 2 systems for us and we couldn’t be happier with the recommendations and level of professionalism him and his team exhibited.When I was conducting my research on solar panels, there is a lot of information out there and it can be confusing. What I observed was, whilst you can shop around and find other solar providers that are able to sell you a system, follow up customer service from these providers are below expectation.Rory stood out from amongst the barrage of sales pitches we received from multiple solar companies. Rory comprehensive knowledge into each system, flawless installation from Jordan and the team, and provided exceptional follow up customer service. He is punctual to the installation date, easy to contact for any questions and easy to deal with during the sales process, installation and post installation follow up.We would not hesitate to recommend Rory and Liteforce for any household in WA thinking about installing solar panels for their home.

Very Happy with the service and installation from Lite Force seeing savings all ready Rory and team easy to deal with very informative and does a quality install very rare to see the owner of the buisness on the job and carrying out the work

From quote to completed installation, dealing with Rory at Lite Force has been a pleasure.  3 options were quoted promptly and clearly following our initial approach, and Rory followed up with additional information and suggestions in answer to our questions.  We then agreed on a system scope and price, and an installation timeline was put forward according to the Lite Force team’s next Esperance visit.  This didn’t suit us, as we were planning a trip north - so Rory readily made an adjustment for a later installation to suit us.  At all times, he worked hard to keep us informed of his movements and the requirements of our mains power supplier - and the installation today was worked through professionally and without fuss.  We’re extremely happy with not only the quality of product but also the quality of workmanship and have no hesitation in recommending Lite Force to others who are looking for a first rate solar installation.

Rory was professional and communicated effectively from start to finish. He quotes system was straight forward and offered multiple options to give us the best system for our needs. Weather meant that our install had to be delayed but due to Rory clear and honest phone call this delay caused no issues and I never felt stresses or on "tradie house arrest"The install it self went as smooth as silk the placement of the panels was done with care. The team avoided our patio sky lights without us having to micromanage and everyone of his employees was top notch. We have had this system for a year now and never had a problem.
Rory at Lite force is a great guy very infomative in the lead up to installing the system he also carries out the installation

Having had at least 15 quotes from various suppliers, I decided to take a risk on this smaller company.  Rory said at the outset: "I won't be the cheapest, but I'll give you the right advice and do a top quality job" - and he was right.  I chose Lite Force because everything was straightforward - no jabs at other suppliers, no pushing particular panel or inverter brands, just solid factual advice and the information I needed to make a decision on what to buy.  Lite Force was also the only supplier to note that I might have a slight shading problem at certain times of the day but they also gave me the solution (Tigo optimisers on the end panel in each row).The installation was well planned, neat and highly professional - and they cleaned up everything at the end of day.  The installation team was polite and courteous and completed the job in the time stated. The handover documentation was accurate and complete - I didn't need to go back to them and ask questions.Brilliant!

We had Rory and the boys from Lite Force Pty Ltd fit our fronius  6.6kw system with qcell panels a couple of months back we couldn't of had a more easy bunch of people to deal with Rory was straight up front with every thing costing time frame etc and when it came to the day of fitting Rory and the boys were great and did a fantastic job i would be happy to recomend them to anyone on my experience cheers Rory and team from LITE FORCE

We had several quotes before choosing Lite Force. Rory gave us good advice, and his team, lead by Jordan, were up on the roof in gale force winds, doing the installation, even though I would've been happy to postpone for their sake. They did an excellent installation, a good comprehensive handover with the Fronius phone app, arranged all paperwork with Synergy, and Rory even did a follow up call-out to make sure we were completely satisfied. Yes we were, to the point of referring our neighbour on to Lite Force who is booked in for an instal soon.

Very professional installation from start to finish. All necessary approvals and meter change completed on time. The installation of the panels was done on the day arranged, flawlessly and to a very high standard, paying attention to details.All in all a first class job and I would highly recommend Lite Force based on my experience.
Installation was fantastic. Very professional with the team walking us through every step of the process, Service post installation has also been seamless.
the entire process went well. Rory was very professional and the installation was great

Rory from Lite Force was one of three quotes I received through Solar Quotes. All three were good solid quotes and very professional. However Rory was local and went the extra mile with regards to service, listening to our needs and recommending a system that would best suite our needs now and well into the future, given the size of this investment. I found him very available and being local very easy to deal with. His advise was invaluable and we are very pleased with the large installation at our working farm in Treeton near Cowaramup.I would recommend Rory and Lite Force to any prospective customers looking for the appropriate solar system to suite their immediate needs as well as future proofing their investment into green energy.

I received three quotes for the install of a new solar system and removal of the old one. Although the quote from Rory Herbert at  Lite Force was not the lowest, I accepted it because Rory came across as being straight forward and honest. The install was on time and all of the bits and pieces were tidied up and removed leaving my yard spotless. The unit has been working extremely well for eight months now and I have no complaints whatever with Rory or Lite Force. Thanks for a top job.

Extremely happy with the solar system from Liteforce. We previously had some door to door salesman give us a price which was way off the mark. We were then referred to  Liteforce solar from a friend. They were reasonably priced and they didnâ€™t disappoint. I would have no hesitation recommending Liteforce to anyone.

Rory from Liteforce was quick to respond after initial contact. The quote he gave me seemed fair with good quality components being used.Installation and quality of install was top notch. Being a tradesman myself I take notice of good workmanship and Rory and his team do great work.After the installation was complete Rory gave us a thorough run down of the system and checked in a few weeks later to m a ke sure everything was ok.Great work Rory and crew we are really happy.

Had a system installed by Lite Force mid 2019. Our normal bills were around $250 - $300. The first one after installation was $35. The next 2 have been credits.Delighted with the system and the service.Highly recommend.Thanks

A big thanks to you & team for the amazing job/solar installation at our home, the attention to detail & saving costs on electrical by adding in the extra PowerPoint & sensors while on site.Start to finish best service, only installer to come out to our home to meet, explain the installation processes/systems in detail so you understand & get the most out of your system possible.Would highly recommend. 5*

Rory is very knowledgeable, not pushy, patient and offers excellent customer service. He returned  to help with app installation when out internet wouldn't connect.The team who installed our panels were effecient, tidy and pleasant young gentlemen.I would unreservedly recommend Liteforce based on my experience.

Rory at Lite Force was excellent throughout the entire solar installation process. He gave really succinct and simple information at the quoting stage which resulted in us getting the perfect solar setup for our needs.Installation and setup was very professional and neat. We are glad that we made this investment. We would definitely recommend Lite Force to anyone looking for a tradesmen who knows the industry and strives for precision.

You should trust this company, They provide very honest information and are not just trying to sell you the most expensive option but the most practical and best suited for your requirements. I saved $$$ going with their  recommendation. They will provide options for you to consider. Installers are great under the watchful eyes of Jordan...Great attention to detail all around.

Rory was a pleasure to deal with. He and his team do the work personally, unlike many other firms that sub contract the work out. Rory identified a number of issues while doing the quote that we could sort out before deciding on the final system to be installed. For example we are in an outer metro area and have dual phase rather than single or three phase power. This meant we could not have one single phase string inverter but needed two equal string inverters, substantially increasing the cost. In the end we chose micro inverters on each panel which were a similar price to two single phase inverter and come with other advantages. As we are on a rural property it is some distance to the meter box and Rory had to do the calculations to determine if the existing cables were sufficient, luckily they were. Rory presented a number of options and quotes to which I made a number of changes until I settled on the final option. Rory happily worked through each of these quotes and options with me. In the end Roryâ€™s quote was comparable to the others but came with much greater certainty to other firms who took the approach that I would have to pay more if the subcontractors encounter issues once they arrived to do the job. Rory was always punctual and tidy, he handled all of the connection and rebate issue.  I am more than happy to recommend Rory and Lightforce.
Quoting process was easy to understand and very reasonably priced and the installation was quick and professional.

We had Rory come out and complete a quote for us. He was fantastic and discussed what our needs were and what we were hoping to get out of Solar. He discussed options with us and left us detailed quotes at different prices levels with information about the specifications of each system for us to decide what suited our budget and needs without pressure. He answered all our questions and asked us questions we hadn't even though to ask.The installation work was done to an amazing level. The site was cleaned up perfectly. Even when some things went wrong with the install (heavy wind and rain part way through the day meant that they needed to come back another day, and a faulty inverter that didn't work properly when first installed and needed to be replaced) Rory was amazingly professional and discussed the issues with us and we were able to rework the installation date to get everything installed. His problem solving and customer service was fantastic in overcoming problems.Rory was super friendly and helpful in getting our solar set up and running and would highly recommend him to anyone wishing to install solar. The experience and level of service received was second to none.

After reviewing multiple quotes from various suppliers Rory from Lite Force made time on a Sunday for a site visit and discuss options for solar.Quote was received within a couple of days with different options and a recommendation to install the smart meter for real time date. Quote was very competitive with previous ones received but with higher end components.Install was a two part process as we were having the roof changed from tiles to colorbond.  I notified Rory one day before the tiles were removed and the team pre-wired the system the next day.Installation was carried out in a day by the team and attention to detail was a standout for me and really finished off the install. The system was fully explained at handover and the savings have been instant for us after only a month or two.Wish we did it earlier and would recommend Rory & Team to anyone wanting a quality job at a good price

After getting quote we did have a delay before installation however living in Esperance we are a bit remote but when the installation started it was done with the very best of care with regards to it being unobstrusive and with a lot of pride in their work would recommend Rory and his team to anyone very happy.

Rory and his team did a fantastic job. From start to finish the whole process went without a hitch. Neat and tidy and a really professional job. Rory has a real pride in his work that shows through in his attention to detail and the way he managed the job. His team were polite and respectful. We were really impressed with how easy it was.
Very pleased with the service and outcome. Thank you Rory and team!

From the first discussion I could quickly gather Rory was not just selling solar panels but had a good understanding of the larger renewable energy market and energy consumption reduction opportunities.  As an electrician the work was not subcontracted and he had his own company and own staff work on the preparation and installation.  Due to challenges with the approvals, due to the system size I was going for, he kept me updated and quickly provided updated estimates adjusted for the changes needed to secure the approvals.  From start to end the communication was good, installation punctual, quick and clean.  Limitations of the single phase system were explained and resulted in purchasing a 3-phase upgrade for the house as part of the work. All the pre-work and costs to upgrade to a 3-phase system were very clear and well justified and aligned to my plans future proofing the installation for expansions in the future.  Overall a pleasure to deal with from start to end.  While Rory was not on site all the time he made a point of swinging by at least once a day, the team were well supervised on-site and constantly calling back to re-confirm decisions.  Well oiled team from my experience.

Thank you for your time and advice as we required a 3 phase system.  The peace of mind of dealing with Western Power plus our semirural location had a few wrinkles but we did not have to worry.  Amazing service plus super team installing.
Quotation process was promptly atteneded to.Installation was efficient.After sales service was prompt.

Very efficient and professional service from Rory and his team. Good advice on placement and a fair, competitive price. Removed and took away the old system and installation although a little delayed, was completed efficiently.
Super efficient and friendly, the whole process was very smooth! Could not recommend enough.

Rory and the team were punctual, polite, easy to deal with and responsive to any questions. Getting the quote and then arranging the installation was quick and troublefree. I would definitely recommend Lite Force

From start to finish the team at Lite Force solar where easy to deal with and gave great information.For the initial on site visit and quote the info was clear and direct.  There was no up-selling over the top products and extras, the options where clear and no push for sales.The install team where on time clean and polite.  I am a big one for trades cleaning up after themselves and respecting my property,  the job  was completed on time with no issue. The guys even went beyond to help me with providing space in the meter box for the pool circuit. I informed them that we where having a pool installed and they set the meter box up so i didnt need to pay for another electrician down the track.

Rory being an installer as well as selling his own experience was a breath of fresh air honest as well as genuine. Sold the system and installed it ,shifted tv antennas and went beyond what I was expecting. was awesome.

The whole process flowed really easily, the system is working great, no problems and western power inspectors just did there inspection and said this was a good job done. This was one of the easiest things I have had done. This is Because Rory has it together, he is organised and does the paperwork straight away he is on the ball the whole time. Itâ€™s his business and he is passionate and there is pride in his work. Beware of others that self endorse, it is no recommendation. His customers are the proof of praise.

Rory and the team weâ€™re onsite at the agreed time and carried out the install professionally and efficiently. They explained all the processes to me and kept me up to speed as they worked. They left the site tidy when they finished. All aspects of connection and how to remotely access the system were explained as they did the final setup. Had one minor issue early on with internet connectivity and they were onsite the next day to rectify it.

Rory is a professional and friendly installer. The installation was executed very well even though the accessibility of the roof wasn't ideal. Rory does the installation himself and provided excellent follow up post installation. The connection to the grid was seamless. The average usage has reduced significantly.
Very efficient and professional service. System is functioning very well.
Rory was very helpful and professional. His team of installers were fast and very respectful. Everything was up and running in a day and haven't had a problem since.

Rory and his team where very professional. The solar panel and inverter installation were completed quickly and they did a fantastic job, leaving the job site neat and tidy. We would recommend Lite Force to take on any solar installation.

Hi all, I highly recommend Rory and his team he was on time and did the job he guaranteed he would do.Rory turned up promptly to do my quote, he gave me several options to choose from and answered all my questions when asked. Once I decided to go with Rory we lcoked in a date and time for my install, the day came I received a call 15mins prior to arrival to be sure I was ready.  The install went really well everything looks great and works well, I have a slight addiction to the smart meter App now and love watching my return build.  I wasn't home for the end of the install due to work, my Wife was in so received all the info on how to run our new system.  I spoke to Rory about this he said I am more then happy to drop back at a later date at a time convenient to me and run me through it, it turns out I didn't need him to do that but was great that the offer was there, again I would recommend Lite Force to friends and fam for sure.

We are happy with the overall performance of the system,and we are glad we went with the more expensive system.Customer service was prompt and follow up after installation of the system was excellent.Power costs have reduced by approx. 60%.
Exceptional service from start to finish with attention to detail and efficiency

Ok, so I rarely "ever" give anything a top rating but I was tempted to do so in this case.Lite Force have provided a great service. In the initial discussions I found they provided a little more information than some other installers. Some other quotes I saw had quite a bit of information too but Lite Force had the information, price and used equipment that made them a clear best choice. The installers did a great job, they were courteous, arrived and carried out the installation when as previously arranged.The system has only been installed for a few days so I don't know how it will go long term but it is performing very well so far.I recommend anyone considering a Solar system install by Lite Force to give them a second look if your undecided, the experience I have had with them has been excellent.

Lite Force Pty Ltd provided a very professional service from the very first home visit and quote through to post installation follow-up and advice. The quality of the solar power product represented good value for money, with sound advice and guidance through the product selection phase. Installation of the solar power system was also of a good quality, with the Lite Force on-site staff being very respectable and trustworthy. I would have no problem, based on my recent experience, in recommending Lite Force Pty Ltd to family and friends.

Rory from Liteforce was fantastic, we received a number of quotes and Rory was the most professional and friendly. He was always available to answer any questions that arose when speaking to other salespeople and I found him to be the most trustworthy and definitely not pushy like some. The install went smoothly and his team were all very friendly and helpful. I can recommend Rory and his team highly.

I found Lite Force through this site after reading the reviews.I had had quotes from some of the bigger companies previously on similar systems for much more money so I was happy that I could get a quality system at a better price.When I met Rory (who owns Lite Force) his manner and style for describing the Solar system was quite impressive. He will tell you himself he is no salesman but he comes across as quite genuine, knowledgeable and likeable.When they (Lite Force) arrived to fit the system on the day we on; they were on time ready to start.There were no issues that I was aware of and all went smoothly. No swearing or fooling around so ok if the kids are around. lolEverything was left clean and tidy. A job well done.Rory took care of all the paperwork from start to finish so nothing there for me to do.I highly recommend Lite Force if you are looking for Solar systems.

Rory and the Liteforce team were an absolute pleasure to deal with. They are friendly, professional, open and honest. Unlike many companies who have salespeople sitting behind a desk viewing your property via outdated online aerial photos, Rory came to our home and inspected the roof personally.Rory has been helpful and supportive in every step of this process and has continued to answer texts and emails after install promptly with further questions and queries we've had. I can't recommend Rory and his team enough. It's also really great that we were able to support him and his local small business.

Rory from Liteforce who quoted the system was rigorous in his assessment of what was required.  As Rory was also the installer I had confidence that he would do a good job.  I have been very happy with his service and system he installed.

I spent a lot of time researching and reading reviews before narrowing my choice down to three (all local, small business, owned by qualified electricians who came onsite themselves at the first visit). It was a hard decision, all three would have provided 5 star service, and their prices and installation dates were similar. In the end, we chose Rory from LiteForce as he took time to understand our needs, made honest and sensible recommendations and also installed a three air conditioners and upgraded our circuit board for us. Rory is easy to contact and responds quickly to texts and e-mails. His staff did a great job and cleaned up afterwards, it was like they had never been there :)

Rory and his team were outstanding.  He was the only  one that came out of the three  and actually gave the time to do aa proper written quote  and emailed it through. The other companies use sales people, but Rory was an electrician, owner and installer Highly recommend Liteforce. I had inztalled what  i needed

Very happy with the time frame that was agreed to and it ran like clockwork!No inconvenience to my guests and no down time for my business. Itâ€™s defiantly worth looking at the quality and backup service first then the cost!!Roryâ€™s boys were easy to have around and cleans up as expected! can defiantly recomend Lite ForceMike

Great dealings with Rory from the initial conversation/quote to the install.Rory knows his stuff and is a certified electrician. After exhaustive research on solar, we concluded that not only does Rory sell the best quality/best price equipment but actually does the full install as well. This was very important to us re the fear of dodgy sub contractors and who to deal with down the line if anything goes wrong.Also good is that the business is his own (nice to deal with the owner from start to finish) and that you are helping to grow his business rather than a faceless, larger company that have jumped onto the solar bandwagon.The price was accurate down to the cent and the work was carried out on time by Rory and co worker in a professional and friendly way.I am very happy to recommend Liteforce for all your solar needs.PaulWattle Grove

I discovered I needed some roof work done after having booked Lite Force to install my PV system. They were wonderfully flexible and did my installation in two parts, coming on the same day as the roof trades to do the work that would disrupt the rood (install the feet onto which the panels were later attached).Always arrived on time for every appointment, all the guys were friendly and polite.I'd had a PV system in the past so knew what I wanted and it was evident Rory knows his stuff. Can't beat dealing with the owner of the business.

I accepted 3 quotes to install a solar system on my residence. Rory was first to contact me and the only company to ask for a site visit to understand all aspects of the impending contract. After a visit by Rory and a clear message from him that the other competitor's where going to give me a very sound service, I decided on Rory -Lite Force Pty Ltd. He was not the cheapest (within $200-$300), but the effort and personal contact meant a lot to me. His team installed the system at my residence at Mandurah within one day, and although this is day one of my experience, I have enjoyed it and very comfortable with the process going forward. Highly recommended.

Rory was the first  installer to contact and was prompt in setting up a quote. The quotes were in line with current market costs and the installation was efficiently completed by Rory and the team. I would easily recommend this installer.

Rory has excellent knowledge of the equipment he is supplying and is able to offer a number of packages to suit the customers requirements.  There was good communication leading to install and they showed up at the agreed time.  Excellent job done of the install/cleanup and his team very were polite and courteous.  Would recommend Lite Force to future customers.  The whole process was painless and they stand behind the work they do.

It was great to be able to deal with the owner and installer of the company. I had several other companies come and quote but they were sales people who I would probably never see again but dealing with Rory (owner/installer) and his team I was assured that the job would be done in the best possible way to the best standard. It was a pleasure to deal with Rory and the Lite Force team. Everything happened as planned and we were informed regularly of any changes.

It was a pleasure dealing with Rory and his small crew from start to finish. I really can't recommend Lite Force highly enough.Note that Lite Force is unlikely to be the cheapest quote you receive - the large solar sales companies will almost certainly beat them on price for a directly comparable system. I've still given five stars for value though because in my opinion the slight premium charged by Lite Force is entirely justified by the quality install and seamless experience that comes with having the entire process - from quoting through to final commissioning - undertaken by the same licensed electrical contractor. Not dealing with non-technical sales guys or subcontractors. Awesome.
Rory was very knowledgeable and great answering my questions. The installation was quick and neat and Iâ€™m very happy with my system, everythingâ€™s working well.

Great customer service. Rory turned met me pre-quote to explain what he could offer, and assess the property. He then produced a number of different options and prices, and provided us with a details analysis of our property. One extra positive is that your dealing with the owner and installer directly, not some sales person. Install day they were great, friendly and neat. We did have a few issues on the western power side, but Rory dealt with it quickly and kept us in the loop at all times.
Although Rory wasn't hands on, his employee Jordan was easy to deal with
Rory from lite force was extremely helpfully and easy to deal with. Highly recommend

We spent a couple of months researching and obtaining quotes before deciding on which system was best for us.  Rory was the only person who told us about 'overclocking' and explained the importance of correct ratios.  We used this information to chose our type of Enphase system.  The instillation was efficient and the whole team was friendly and communicated well with us.  We couldn't be happier and thoroughly recommend Lite Force to anyone considering any type of system.
Rory at Liteforce was fabulous and thanks for your help

Rory at Liteforce was a no nonsense provider that got straight to the point and provided an excellent price for a 5kw Fronius inverter and 23 Talsun panels to create a 6.6kw system.He has his own staff and doesnâ€™t use contractors, got back to me regarding all my enquiries including what quality of silicon was in the panels (a grade), the aesthetic look of the panels on my roof and took me through all the process and safety shutdown procedures.
Very happy with the quotes and my choice.  Good quality system at a reasonable price installed by competent professionals.

Couldnt be happier . Rory was excellent to deal with. Took time to explain the whole process thoroughly. What suited my granny flat best.  Position etc. Prompt with appointments and work carried out as planned, leaving the site as found. Hassle free. Would recommend Lite Force to prospective  solar buyers.

After receiving quotes from salesmen who came to the door I had become quite confused and disillusioned.  I saw a billboard advertisement for Lite Force and decided to contact them for a quote and Iâ€™m so glad I did.  The owner of Lite Force, Rory Herbert provided me with a quote that I was more than happy with. He took the time to listen to my requirements and suggested a system which could provide me with my wants. The system he installed is performing beyond my expectations and has already slashed my bills considerably and I have received a credit back. The workmanship shown by his crew and himself was very impressive ensuring they kept  a safe and tidy work environment at all times.  Rory has also taken the time to come back and check the system is working correctly and is always only a phone call away

The professionalism and knowledge shown by the young men and owner operator Rory Herbert at Liteforce was remarkable.  From the initial quote to the day of installation everything ran smoothly, and all of my questions were answered thoroughly and I was given an extensive run through on how the system and app worked.  They took pride in their work and ensured they cleaned up after themselves.  Rory has made contact, and visited since the system was installed to ensure we were happy with it, and if we had any issues.
Very professional , great product and excellent service.system has performed as described.ihave no hesitation in recommending  Rory and his Liteforce team
Really enjoyed dealing with Rory. Liked the fact that he has an electrical business rather than just solar installation so will be around in the future if something goes wrong.

We obtained 3 quotes from Solar Quotes. The first two were well presented but were from company salesmen who didn't have all the answers on the spot. The third from Lite Force was from Rory, the owner/operator/installer and electrician who was able to answer all our questions without being at all evasive.
